fields.editor:
It's never a good time see a warning light on your dashboard, that's why we are here, to take the worry out of warning lights!

If your Airbag warning light is on this signifies that you have a fault somewhere on your Airbag system which needs to be checked a.s.a.p.

When turning on the ignition, the Airbag light should turn on and then off after a few seconds. If the Airbag light remains on and doesn't turn off, your Airbag module will need to be reset.

Here at KAM Servicing we have the latest diagnostic equipment, and most Airbag problems can be fixed the same day.
